source_title: Ulster undone by five-try Stormers in Cape Town
source_excerpt:
Ulster are now without a win in their opening five United Rugby Championship fixtures
Tries: Schickerling, De Villiers, Roos, R Nel, Ahmed Cons: Ahmed 4
Ulster's search for an opening win in this season's United Rugby Championship [URC] goes on as they fell to a 33-7 defeat by the Stormers in Cape Town.
Richie Murphy's side have now played five domestic fixtures which have produced three defeats and two draws.
Following last week's defeat by the Bulls in Pretoria, Ulster went into this second game of the South Africa tour without their Ireland contingent, who reported back before November's Nations Championship fixtures.
It left them with some gaps to plug, but they would perform admirably for much of this contest as David McCann powered over for the opening score.
However, quickfire tries before the break gave the hosts the lead and a third from Evan Roos minutes into the second period left them in a hole they never really looked like getting out of.
It is a fourth win from five URC fixtures for the Stormers, but far from a perfect display with plenty of unforced errors, yet they produced more than enough to prevail.
Ulster will now have to wait until they visit Cardiff on 5 December for their next opportunity to grab an opening league win.
In an error-strewn opening half, handling errors would halt Stormers' momentum on a number of occasions and eventually see them punished midway through the opening half.
McCann pounced on a knock-on to get his side on the front foot and although the TMO ruled out a score for Matthew Devine from the subsequent attack, play came back for an offside in the build-up and it was McCann who bundled over with Murphy converting.
A knock-on at the line by Cormac Izuchukwu saw Ulster spurn a glorious opportunity to grab a second just minutes later as momentum flipped with Ulster conceding four-straight penalties - the last of those resulting in Keynan Knox sent to the bin.
Pressure would eventually tell as JD Schickerling powered over and Ahmed added the extras before Paul de Villiers charged down Murphy's attempted clearance and took advantage to touch down to give Stormers a 12-7 advantage at the half.
Ulster were on the front foot early in the second period, but a blind pass by Devine was gleefully gathered by Roos, who put on the afterburners and galloped away for a converted score.
It left Murphy's side with a mountain to climb in the Cape Town heat as they could not make their presence felt in the opposite 22, the game played mostly in their own half as both sides continued to make errors.
However, it would finally stick for the hosts as a perfectly-weighted crossfield kick by Ahmed was fielded by team captain Ruhan Nel, who touched down for the bonus point.
Izuchukwu was denied a consolation score when held up over the line which summed up Ulster's day as the hosts finished with a flourish, Ahmed crossing for a fifth he would convert.
It put a seal on the win for the hosts, with Ulster now left with much to ponder as the first block of URC games comes to a conclusion.
While they continue to produce moments, Murphy's side are yet to find a fully-rounded display to get their season fully on track.

Replacements: Rabe, Matongo, FouchÃ©, Norton, Evans, Mlaba, Pead, Simelane.
Ulster: McIlroy; Lowry, Hume, Carson, Ward; Murphy, Devine; O'Sullivan, Herring, Knox, Donnell, Snyman, Izuchukwu, McCann (capt), Augustus.
Replacements: Walker, McAllister, Wilson, Sheridan, Moloney, McKee, Flannery, Mullins.

## परिचय
केपटाउन में खेले गए युनाइटेड रुबी चैंपियनशिप [URC] मुकाबले में स्टॉर्मर्स ने अल्स्टर को 33-7 से हरा दिया। इस हार के साथ ही अल्स्टर की टीम इस सीज़न के शुरुआती पांच मैचों में भी जीत दर्ज करने में नाकाम रही है। 

## मैच का हाल
मैच के दौरान रिचर्ड मर्फी की अल्स्टर टीम बिना अपने आयरलैंड के खिलाड़ियों के उतरी थी, जो नवंबर के नेशंस चैंपियनशिप मुकाबलों से पहले लौट गए थे। इसके बावजूद, मैच की शुरुआत में डेविड मैकैन ने ट्राई करके अल्स्टर को बढ़त दिलाई। 

हालाँकि, पहले हाफ के अंत से पहले स्टॉर्मर्स ने वापसी की और जेडी शिकरिंग तथा पॉल डी विलियर्स के ट्राइयों की बदौलत 12-7 की बढ़त बना ली। दूसरे हाफ की शुरुआत में इवान रूझ ने स्टॉर्मर्स के लिए तीसरा ट्राई किया। इसके बाद कप्तान रुहान नेल और अहमद ने भी ट्राई करके स्टॉर्मर्स की जीत को पक्का कर दिया।

## मुख्य बातें और आंकड़े
* **अल्स्टर का प्रदर्शन:** सीज़न के शुरुआती पांच घरेलू मुकाबलों में तीन हार और दो ड्रा।
* **स्टॉर्मर्स के ट्राई स्कोरर:** शिकरिंग, डी विलियर्स, रूझ, आर नेल और अहमद।
* **अल्स्टर का अगला मैच:** 5 दिसंबर को कार्डिफ़ का दौरा।

## आगे की राह
अल्स्टर की टीम को इस सीज़न की अपनी पहली लीग जीत के लिए अब 5 दिसंबर तक इंतजार करना होगा, जब वे कार्डिफ़ के खिलाफ मैदान पर उतरेंगे। मूल घोषणा और अन्य विवरणों की पुष्टि के लिए आधिकारिक टूर्नामेंट वेबसाइट या संबंधित क्लब के खेल विज्ञापनों की जांच की जा सकती है।

en_body:
## Ulster's Winless Run Continues in South Africa

Ulster remain without a victory in the opening five fixtures of the United Rugby Championship following a 33-7 defeat against the Stormers in Cape Town. 

Richie Murphy's side concluded their South Africa tour with the loss, having previously faced the Bulls in Pretoria. Ulster entered the fixture without their Ireland contingent, who had returned ahead of November's Nations Championship fixtures, leaving the squad with notable gaps to fill.

## Match Breakdown

Despite the personnel challenges, Ulster opened the scoring after David McCann capitalized on an opponent knock-on. Although a subsequent try by Matthew Devine was ruled out by the TMO, play was brought back for an offside, allowing McCann to bundle over with Murphy successfully kicking the conversion.

However, handling errors and penalties proved costly for the visitors:

* Cormac Izuchukwu spilled the ball at the try line, missing a chance to extend Ulster's lead.
* Consecutive penalties led to Keynan Knox being sent to the sin-bin.
* JD Schickerling broke through to score for the Stormers, followed quickly by Paul de Villiers charging down a clearance attempt to touch down.
* Evan Roos intercepted a blind pass early in the second half to extend the hosts' lead to 12-7 at the break.

As the game progressed in the Cape Town heat, the Stormers secured the bonus point through a crossfield kick fielded by captain Ruhan Nel. Replacement scores, including a final converted try by Ahmed, sealed a 33-7 victory for the home side. Izuchukwu was also held up over the line late in the match as Ulster sought a consolation score.

## Practical Implications and Verification

With this result, the Stormers claim their fourth win from five URC matches, while Ulster's domestic record stands at three defeats and two draws from five outings. 

* **Next Fixture:** Ulster will look for their first league win of the season when they travel to face Cardiff on 5 December.
* **How to Verify:** Official match reports, statistics, and upcoming fixture details can be verified through the official United Rugby Championship website or BBC Sport's rugby union coverage.
